name: H4 — Reply watcher → classify → Klyro API

meta.description: Gmail trigger per mailbox (label klyro/replies, -from:me). Strips quoted history, sends the clean reply text to /internal/replies which classifies via Gemini and stops the enrollment / advances the deal. Map the Gmail thread to an enrollmentId via a lookup you maintain, or pass threadId and let the API match. Requires Gmail OAuth credential.
